name: Pokémon Elite Redux
summary:
Pokémon Elite Redux is a ROM hack of Pokemon Emerald, with a focus on buffing all Pokémon and having increased difficulty and teambuilding variety.
In this romhack, all Pokémon have up to four abilities, with usually three inherent ones and one that usually has the ability to be swapped with three others. Multiple major enhancements have been added, such as an in-battle damage calculator, the ability to quickly find and obtain Pokémon in an area, and the ability to instantly set EVs, IVs, and Levels.
The game features all Pokémon from up to the latest DLC content in Scarlet and Violet. Furthermore, it includes new Pokémon and forms, such as new Mega Evolutions (including the conversion of previous Gigantamax forms into new ones), "Redux" regional forms, Covergent Pokémon, and new Paradox Pokémon.
